platform_BootPerf: add metrics for duration between major events Add metrics: - seconds_startup_to_chrome_exec - seconds_chrome_exec_to_login - rdbytes_startup_to_chrome_exec - rdbytes_chrome_exec_to_login After that, each boot stage has its own metrics. This helps us triage issues. - *_power_on_to_kernel: the main owner could probably be firmware - *_kernel_to_startup: the main owner could probably be kernel - *_startup_to_chrome_exec: the main owner could probably be chromeos - *_chrome_exec_to_login: the main owner could probably be chrome These new segmented metrics are also more stable and make bisect easier. BUG=b:123270014 TEST=BootPerfServerCrosPerf Change-Id: Ida3abf7ea7bce50e13eb9a3d1b25c655fe767f99 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1447293 Commit-Ready: Kuang-che Wu <kcwu@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kuang-che Wu <kcwu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kuang-che Wu <kcwu@chromium.org>
